future_held_source_protocol.calibration: Fit only on source-held predictions and labels from remaining development sources. No evaluated-source prevalence, threshold, class weight, or eligibility enters fitting.
future_held_source_protocol.decoder: One source-agnostic gene-ranking head. A source-specific query token or head cannot score a source that was wholly removed.
future_held_source_protocol.graph_removal: Remove held-source edges, inverse edges, nodes, source tokens, provenance, observability, attention-mask entries, positional or structural encodings, paths, aggregates, degrees, source counts, normalized features, and aliases before tokenizer fitting.
future_held_source_protocol.negative_sampling: Sample only within each remaining source's explicitly tested eligible universe. Missing, untestable, not-applicable, join-unresolved, and absent evidence are not negatives.
future_held_source_protocol.node_universe: Freeze source-independent variants, loci, and genes. Held-source-only nodes and coverage are evaluator-only.
future_held_source_protocol.split: Group native-build LD blocks, loci, genes, aliases, exact sequences, and deterministic derivatives before graph or token construction.
future_held_source_protocol.success_interpretation: Cross-source support recovery can prioritize a genetically anchored candidate. It cannot supply causal attribution.

induction_contract.feature_lane: Future only. Requires source-independent feature transforms and no per-entity embedding or query-time graph refit.
induction_contract.new_edge_type: unsupported unless a separately justified trained compositional relation rule exists
induction_contract.new_node_type: unsupported unless type parameters and query transform were trained before holdout

missingness_and_semantics.missingness_rule: Explicit state and mask; never substitute zero for held, untested, unavailable, or inapplicable evidence.
missingness_and_semantics.scientific_language: Use colocalized or genetically anchored candidate and prioritization. Never causal gene from COLOC or model attention.

reproducibility_contract.architecture_receipt: Required before any model code is written: implementation revision, license, type ontology, tokenizer, order, attention mask, positional encodings, decoder, loss, negatives, calibration, optimizer, early stopping, and seeds.
reproducibility_contract.graph_receipt: Hash promoted input rows, canonical nodes, typed directed edges, inverse edges, evidence states, source provenance, removed source, masks, and every graph-derived feature before fitting.
reproducibility_contract.statistical_unit: independent locus; seeds, tokens, heads, edges, genes, variants, guides, and cells are not independent biological replicates
